name: Froglet
description: Single-tool Froglet integration for local services, receipts, and settlement.

baseUrl.description: Legacy unified Froglet control API base URL. When set, it is used for both providerUrl and runtimeUrl.

marketplaceUrl.description: Froglet marketplace API base URL used by marketplace_register.

marketplaceArbiterUrl.description: Froglet marketplace arbiter API base URL used by complaint filing and reads.

providerAuthTokenPath.description: Filesystem path to the Froglet provider control API bearer token.

runtimeAuthTokenPath.description: Filesystem path to the Froglet runtime API bearer token.

authTokenPath.description: Legacy shared bearer token path used as a fallback for both providerAuthTokenPath and runtimeAuthTokenPath.
